q1: unchanged direct baseline answer; no Q1 inference in any policy
existing_policies: baseline, previous_agent and candidate are exactly the PR56/57 gold policies (configs/q1_fixed_q2_cues_q3_legacy_gold_v1.json); saved gold steps are reused when prompt and image bytes match
matched_reask_q2: direct Q2 answer, then one own-answer re-check without definitions (2 calls, same as previous_agent direct + define)
matched_reask_q3: direct Q3 answer, then k sequential own-answer re-checks, k = presence/position calls the staged Q3 made for the same image (1 or 2); last valid answer is final, otherwise direct
matched_reask_rationale: repeating the identical greedy direct prompt is degenerate, so each re-check shows the question's own previous answer, as in the Q2 reask
q3_evaluation: image-label presence only; spatial accuracy null
selection: analysis-only control added after gold; no setting is chosen or changed from gold scores
gold_limit: existing gold246 has prior exploratory use; not a new untouched holdout
failure_gate: all planned policies and dependencies must have full coverage, zero errors and zero invalids
